nodes.long_description:
**The human body is not flat. Yet medical imaging and anatomy are still primarily interpreted in two dimensions, creating a gap between data and understanding.**

Work with medical imaging, anatomy atlases, AI segmentation, and digital twins across VR, 3D displays, and 2D systems.

Free access for students. Send your proof of enrollment to info@medicalholodeck.com

# Highlights
- Interactive 3D medical imaging from CT, MRI, and DICOM
- 3D anatomy atlases and virtual dissection
- Real-time collaboration across devices and locations
- Spatial recording for teaching and review
- AI segmentation and patient-specific digital twins (PC-VR)
- One system for VR, 3D displays, 2D screens, and iOS

# Apps
- Medical Imaging – interactive 3D imaging and case review
- Dissection Master – virtual cadaver dissection
- Anatomy Master – 3D anatomy atlas with 2,000+ structures
- RecordXR – record and replay spatial sessions
- Spatial OS – shared spatial environment across devices (PC-VR tethered)
- Medicalholodeck AI – automatic segmentation in seconds (PC-VR tethered for best performance)

# Use cases
Used for anatomy education, simulation, interdisciplinary case discussions, tumor boards, patient communication, and immersive training with real medical data in interactive 3D.

# Important notice
Medicalholodeck is not a certified medical device and is intended for education, communication, training, and research purposes only.
nodes.short_description: Explore anatomy, convert CT, MRI, and DICOM data into interactive 3D, create AI segmentations and digital twins, and collaborate across VR, 3D displays, and 2D systems. Free access for students.

- 教育とレビューのための空間記録

- RecordXR – 空間セッションの記録と再生

# Důležité upozornění
Medicalholodeck není certifikovaný zdravotnický prostředek a je určen pouze pro vzdělávání, komunikaci, trénink a výzkum.
nodes.short_description: Prozkoumejte anatomii, převádějte data CT, MRI a DICOM do interaktivního 3D, vytvářejte segmentace pomocí AI a digitální dvojčata a spolupracujte ve VR, na 3D displejích a 2D systémech. Bezplatný přístup pro studenty.

nodes.long_description:
**Het menselijk lichaam is niet plat. Toch worden medische beeldvorming en anatomie nog steeds vooral in twee dimensies geïnterpreteerd, waardoor er een kloof ontstaat tussen data en begrip.**

Werk met medische beeldvorming, anatomieatlassen, AI-segmentatie en digitale tweelingen in VR, op 3D-schermen en 2D-systemen.

Gratis toegang voor studenten. Stuur je bewijs van inschrijving naar info@medicalholodeck.com

# Hoogtepunten
- Interactieve medische 3D-beeldvorming op basis van CT, MRI en DICOM
- 3D-anatomieatlassen en virtuele dissectie
- Realtime samenwerking tussen apparaten en locaties
- Ruimtelijke opname voor onderwijs en evaluatie
- AI-segmentatie en patiëntspecifieke digitale tweelingen (PC-VR)
- Eén systeem voor VR, 3D-schermen, 2D-schermen en iOS

# Apps
- Medical Imaging – interactieve 3D-beeldvorming en casusbespreking
- Dissection Master – virtuele kadaverdissectie
- Anatomy Master – 3D-anatomieatlas met meer dan 2.000 structuren
- RecordXR – ruimtelijke sessies opnemen en opnieuw afspelen
- Spatial OS – gedeelde ruimtelijke omgeving tussen apparaten (PC-VR via kabel)
- Medicalholodeck AI – automatische segmentatie in enkele seconden (PC-VR via kabel voor de beste prestaties)

# Belangrijke mededeling
Medicalholodeck is geen gecertificeerd medisch hulpmiddel en is uitsluitend bedoeld voor onderwijs, communicatie, training en onderzoek.
nodes.short_description: Verken anatomie, zet CT-, MRI- en DICOM-gegevens om in interactieve 3D, maak AI-segmentaties en digitale tweelingen, en werk samen in VR, op 3D-schermen en 2D-systemen. Gratis toegang voor studenten. Stuur je bewijs van inschrijving naar info@medicalholodeck.com

nodes.long_description:
**İnsan vücudu düz değildir. Buna rağmen tıbbi görüntüleme ve anatomi hâlâ çoğunlukla iki boyutta yorumlanıyor; bu da veri ile anlayış arasında bir boşluk oluşturuyor.**

VR, 3D ekranlar ve 2D sistemlerde tıbbi görüntüleme, anatomi atlasları, AI segmentasyonu ve dijital ikizlerle çalışın.

Öğrenciler için ücretsiz erişim. Kayıt belgenizi info@medicalholodeck.com adresine gönderin

# Öne çıkanlar
- CT, MRI ve DICOM’dan etkileşimli 3D tıbbi görüntüleme
- 3D anatomi atlasları ve sanal diseksiyon
- Cihazlar ve konumlar arasında gerçek zamanlı iş birliği
- Eğitim ve inceleme için uzamsal kayıt
- AI segmentasyonu ve hastaya özel dijital ikizler (PC-VR)
- VR, 3D ekranlar, 2D ekranlar ve iOS için tek sistem

# Uygulamalar
- Medical Imaging – etkileşimli 3D görüntüleme ve vaka inceleme
- Dissection Master – sanal kadavra diseksiyonu
- Anatomy Master – 2.000’den fazla yapı içeren 3D anatomi atlası
- RecordXR – uzamsal oturumları kaydedin ve yeniden oynatın
- Spatial OS – cihazlar arasında paylaşılan uzamsal ortam (kablolu PC-VR)
- Medicalholodeck AI – saniyeler içinde otomatik segmentasyon (en iyi performans için kablolu PC-VR)

# Kullanım alanları
Anatomi eğitimi, simülasyon, disiplinler arası vaka tartışmaları, tümör konseyleri, hasta iletişimi ve gerçek tıbbi verilerle etkileşimli 3D immersif eğitim için kullanılır.

# Önemli bildirim
Medicalholodeck sertifikalı bir tıbbi cihaz değildir ve yalnızca eğitim, iletişim, öğretim ve araştırma amaçlıdır.
nodes.short_description: Anatomiyi keşfedin, CT, MRI ve DICOM verilerini etkileşimli 3D’ye dönüştürün, AI segmentasyonları ve dijital ikizler oluşturun, VR, 3D ekranlar ve 2D sistemlerde birlikte çalışın. Öğrenciler için ücretsiz erişim.

nodes.long_description:
Dissection Master XR is suitable for teaching in classes in VR and for independent preparation of courses and exams. The interactive anatomical 3D data enable a steep learning curve and optimal learning success. 

Dissection Master XR brings human dissections of the highest quality to VR and makes them interactively accessible for medical teaching and education. The entire human body can be studied in multiple layers and discussed in groups in VR. The app is the perfect complement to traditional face-to-face lessons in the anatomy and dissection lab.
nodes.short_description: Dissection Master XR is the dissection and anatomy lab in virtual reality. It presents high-resolution human dissections created especially for anatomy teaching. The entire human body has been carefully dissected and digitized in up to 10 high-resolution layers. All structures relevant for anatomical education on a university level are precisely marked and annotated.
